### Description
A summary of the changes from a code perspective
> e.g. "Add the ability to disable sorting on specific table columns"

### Motivation and Context
A summary of the changes from a business perspective - why is this PR helpful?
> e.g. "Some columns do not make sense to sort, like columns containing icons. This allows us to remove the option to sort on those columns to avoid unexpected behavior."

### How Has This Been Tested?
Talk about some of the testing you did, notable issues, if it affected other areas of the code. This includes any manual testing
> e.g. "I tried disabling sorting on all columns, none, and different subsets to ensure all worked both with and without filters open"

### Screenshots (if UI changes are made):

### Types of changes
- [ ] Refactoring (changing code structure without affecting functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

### Checklist:
- [ ] My change requires a change to the documentation.
    - [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] My change includes testable code
    - [ ] I have added additional tests
